senses.gloss: m. (v. גָּבוֹהַּ a. גִּבֵּחַ) tall and slim.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 22:22">Targ. Y. Lev. XXII, 22</cite> <he>דג׳ או דנסיס</he> Ar. (ed. differ. vers., h. text <he>חרוץ או יבלת</he>) extremely tall or of stinted growth; v. <cite ref="C00083"><he>גְּבִיחַ</he></cite>. [The vers. of Ar. obviously belonged to <cite ref="Leviticus 21:20">Lev. XXI, 20</cite>.]
